biography:
I’m a Cost Manager with 7 years of experience delivering cost planning, procurement, and change management services across commercial, industrial, and mission-critical sectors.

My recent focus has been on supporting data center construction projects, where I’ve partnered with owners and project management teams to drive accurate cost forecasting, manage contractor pricing, and mitigate commercial risk.

I bring strong knowledge of CSI division estimating, change order reviews, contract compliance, and cost reporting aligned with both project controls and stakeholder goals.

Tools I’ve worked with include RSMeans, Bluebeam, Procore, and Revit. I have a working knowledge of NECA and MCAA labor units and regularly interface with trade partners to verify scope and pricing.
